project_7_status_note: #73 stays In Progress through bootstrap and acceptance. Traffic cutover requires a separate Owner decision.

items.title: Production identity and permissions plus Worker-mode dry-run plan
items.evidence: Local dry-run stops at missing AIRINGCAL_ZONE_ID. GitHub production Environment absent, workflow disabled_manually, no active Portable Writer runs and repository schedule gate unset.
items.requiresOwner: Independently scoped Production configuration in gitignored .env.production
items.gate_rule: Verify remote account, zone, R2 and Worker permissions separately. Inspect copy-free Cloudflare-only Worker-mode plan, exact SHA, both Writer gates closed and valid user config.

items.title: Create private empty Production bucket, GitHub Environment and independent Worker
items.command: AIRINGCAL_ENV=production AIRINGCAL_DOTENV_PATH=.env.production AIRINGCAL_PRODUCTION_APPLY_AUTHORIZED=yes AIRINGCAL_DEPLOY_LIVE_CONFIRM=yes node scripts/deploy-env.mjs --apply --i-am-sure-production --target cloudflare
items.gate_rule: No data copy or adoption. Preserve apply ledger. Refuse foreign or published data. Zero R2 Custom Domains and r2.dev disabled. Image routing skipped-no-release.

items.title: Isolation probe PASS on Production public host
items.gate_rule: Authenticated S3 HEAD proves temporary object exists. Anonymous Worker GET/HEAD deny plain and encoded paths. Accept edge 400 for malformed traversal only. Confirm probe deletion and empty bucket.

items.title: Bangumi first Full Sync into empty Production checkpoint
items.requiresOwner: Separate D3 authorization after D2 isolation passes
items.command: portable-writer.yml workflow_dispatch on verified ref with target=production force_mode=full
items.gate_rule: Open only the Production Environment bootstrap gate. Close after the intended job's authorization step succeeds or on failure/timeout. Keep repo schedule gate closed. Record run ID/SHA and actual published release/checkpoint/lease.

items.title: Data integrity one-shot compare vs v2 core fields / collections / calendar
items.requiresOwner: Legacy + Production candidate snapshots; record equal evidence on #73
items.gate_rule: exit 0 and equal:true / diff_count:0 using contemporaneous snapshots. Reconcile legitimate source-time differences explicitly.

items.title: R2 checkpoint/release CAS, image completeness, MIME verification
items.requiresOwner: Live Production bucket after Full Sync
items.gate_rule: Production immutable put, pointer CAS, stale-write rejection, checkpoint fencing and single authority. Verify release references and required images/MIME.

items.title: Cloudflare Worker read, static, public-object and image streaming contract
items.gate_rule: Require real build identity, release integrity, GET/HEAD/405/410/ETag/304/CORS, streamed image originals/thumbnails and unskipped authenticated checkpoint proof.

items.title: Complete Bucket privacy, cache headers and freshness
items.requiresOwner: Live Production Worker and R2 inventory
items.gate_rule: Zero R2 Custom Domains, r2.dev disabled and no anonymous direct bucket or image redirect. Validate Worker checkpoint denial, immutable cache and release freshness.

items.title: Rollback + roll-forward drill PASS
items.requiresOwner: Two legitimate Production generations and separate authorization for any later one-shot dispatch or authoritative pointer mutation
items.gate_rule: Keep both Writer gates closed and verify CAS, stale-write rejection, restoration of accepted pointer/Reader consistency and checkpoint resume rule.

items.title: Owner explicit GO/NO-GO before traffic switch
items.requiresOwner: Record GO or NO-GO on #73; keep old system as rollback until Owner says otherwise
items.gate_rule: Traffic switch only after explicit Owner GO; prep CI green does not imply GO
